_doc: Floors (min) and ceilings (max) on report aggregates, by profile; evals/gate.py picks the profile from the report: offline (--llm fake: FakeLLM pipeline + heuristic judges, a deterministic regression check of the harness), fixture (real models, synthetic library) or live (real models, PubMed / Europe PMC). A metric that was not measured fails. Fixture floors sit below the 2026-10-19 smoke baseline (agreement 0.69, faithfulness 0.66, answer rate 1.0 on 4 in-scope items); live floors are initial guesses until a live baseline exists (see evals/README.md).
